International non-proprietary name (INN): influenza vaccine (surface antigen, inactivated, prepared in cell cultures)
Active substance: A/Wisconsin/67/2022 (H1N1)pdm09-like strain (A/Georgia/12/2022, CVR-167)  A/Massachusetts/18/2022 (H3N2)-like strain (A/Sydney/1304/2022, wild type)  B/Austria/1359417/2021-like strain (B/Singapore/WUH4618/2021, wild type)  B/Phuket/3073/2013-like strain (B/Singapore/INFTT-16-0610/2016, wild type)
Pharmacotherapeutic group\n(human): influenza, inactivated, split virus or surface antigen
Therapeutic indication: Prophylaxis of influenza in adults and children from 2 years of age. Flucelvax Tetra should be used in accordance with official recommendations.
